name: dv-stats
js: (() => {const a=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY,cm=a.controllerManager,DV=C.DON_VALLEY; const g=(x,z,y)=>+cm.getGroundHeight(x,z,'person',y).toFixed(2); return {pilot:!!DV, stats:C.donValleyStats?{plinths:C.donValleyStats.plinths,ms:Math.round(C.donValleyStats.ms),meshes:C.donValleyStats.stats.map(s=>[s.meshes,s.triangles,s.pieces,s.skipped])}:null, patios:C.patioStats&&C.patioStats.fingerprint, viaduct:C.SUBWAY_VIADUCTS.map(v=>({railY:v.railY,deck:v.deck,pilot:!!v.pilot})), ground:{riverUnderViaduct:g(2280,-2880,null), deckOnViaduct:g(2240,-2803,0.4), underViaduct:g(2240,-2803,-30), castleFrank:g(1790,-2720,null), broadview:g(2736,-2840,null), bayviewFloor:g(2205,-2650,null)}, player:a.controllerManager.getActiveEntity().position}; })()

name: dv-deck-chase
js: (() => {const a=window.__CITY_APP,d=window.CITY.SUBWAY_VIADUCTS[0].deck; a.cameraSystem.cinema=null; const p=a.controllerManager.getActiveEntity().position; if(Math.abs(p.y-d)>0.05) throw new Error('Not on the viaduct deck: '+p.y+' (deck '+d+')'); return {player:{x:p.x,y:p.y,z:p.z}};})()

name: dv-castle-frank-platform
js: (() => {const a=window.__CITY_APP,R=a.subwayRide,cm=a.controllerManager; if(!R.enterStation('castle-frank',0)) throw new Error('Could not enter Castle Frank'); const e=cm.getActiveEntity(),p=e.position; if(Math.abs(p.y-cm.interiorSpace.floor)>.01) throw new Error('Wrong platform elevation'); e.heading-=Math.PI/2; a.selectCamera('chase',true); console.log('[ride-check] on Castle Frank platform '+JSON.stringify(p)); return {platform:{x:p.x,y:p.y,z:p.z,floor:cm.interiorSpace.floor}};})()

name: dv-castle-frank-exit
js: (() => {const a=window.__CITY_APP,R=a.subwayRide,cm=a.controllerManager; document.getElementById('ride-cancel').click(); if(R.inside||cm.interiorSpace) throw new Error('Did not leave the station'); const p=cm.getActiveEntity().position; const g=cm.getGroundHeight(p.x,p.z,cm.activeMode); if(Math.abs(p.y-g)>.1) throw new Error('Unsafe street exit'); return {street:{x:p.x,y:p.y,z:p.z,ground:g}};})()

name: dv-seat
js: (() => {const a=window.__CITY_APP; if(!a.rideFeatured('subway')||!a.subwayRide.active) throw new Error('No subway ride'); document.getElementById('locate-prompt').hidden=true;})()

name: dv-seat-crossing
js: (async () => { const a=window.__CITY_APP,R=a.subwayRide,id=R.car.id; a.film.start(10); try { let lo=Infinity,hi=-Infinity; for(let i=0;i<160&&!(R.canChase&&R.car.s>R.car.track.open0+180);i++) {await a.film.step(25); if(!R.active||R.car.id!==id) throw new Error('Train identity lost'); lo=Math.min(lo,R.entity.position.y); hi=Math.max(hi,R.entity.position.y);} if(!R.canChase) throw new Error('Did not reach open viaduct'); a.selectCamera('pov',true); const r={id,s:R.car.s,y:R.entity.position.y,lo,hi}; console.log('[ride-check] valley crossing '+JSON.stringify(r)); return r; } finally {a.film.stop();} })()

name: dv-ride-end
js: (() => {const a=window.__CITY_APP,R=a.subwayRide,cm=a.controllerManager; document.getElementById('ride-cancel').click(); if(R.inside||R.active||a.rideSession.active||cm.interiorSpace) throw new Error('Street restoration failed'); const p=cm.getActiveEntity().position; return {street:{x:p.x,y:p.y,z:p.z,ground:cm.getGroundHeight(p.x,p.z,cm.activeMode)}};})()
